task: T10 route following and deviation handling

behavior.segment_tracking: Cross-track distance is measured to the active segment from the route start/current previous waypoint to the active waypoint. A future segment cannot be selected as a shortcut.
behavior.deviation: Sustained cross-track error triggers stop, plan invalidation, and route recomputation from the current observation while retaining the current goal.
behavior.hazard_priority: Immediate command_blocked check runs before deviation confirmation/cooldown; a scan obstacle still stops motion immediately.

verification.full_backend_suite: backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest backend/tests -q: 204 passed, 2 skipped in 42.84 s.
verification.lateral_drift_integration: SimWorld controller test injected 0.60 m sustained cross-track offset; controller journaled replan, retained goal, and resumed a route.
verification.cooldown_and_obstacle_bypass: Detector test confirmed cooldown suppression; MotionExecutor test confirmed command_blocked returns BLOCKED during cooldown.
verification.syntax_and_diff: py_compile passed for modified runtime/probe modules; git diff --check clean.

live_injection_attempts.status: inconclusive; not counted as T10 acceptance evidence

prior_attempts.status: inconclusive; not counted as T10 acceptance evidence
prior_attempts.first_attempt: Competing Gazebo /scan messages produced a dynamic-obstacle stop during the synthetic odom offset; journal did not contain the off-path replan event.
prior_attempts.second_attempt: With Gazebo scan rate reduced to 0.1 Hz, synthetic scan messages were not accepted by the bridge with fresh simulation timestamps; observations_stale stopped the run.
prior_attempts.recovery: Restored /scan to 5 Hz, verified 4.87 Hz, reset supervisor to easy/seed23/generation0, and recreated backend.

live_injection_attempts.latest_attempt: Gazebo physical pose stream showed backend-to-physical pose gap 0.0072 m and physical robot drift only 0.0035 m. A 0.60 m cross-track odometry offset reached the backend, but /odom observations alternated between the Gazebo publisher and probe. The controller received pose-correction updates and lidar braking before a sustained OFF_PATH event; no deviation-replan journal entry was produced.
live_injection_attempts.probe_change: Probe no longer changes Gazebo scan rate. It re-bins lidar returns to preserve their world points during a localization offset; raw attempt remains diagnostic.
live_injection_attempts.cleanup: Supervisor fully restarted to easy/seed23/generation0, then backend start-stop lifecycle advanced generation1; backend is healthy, stopped, with fresh odom/scan/battery/clock and native battery 59.9966/60.

controlled_live_probe.result: journaled Перепланирование после отклонения; active explore goal remained set after the first sustained lateral offset; test kept physical Gazebo robot stationary while offsetting backend odometry and reprojecting lidar points to retain their world positions.
controlled_live_probe.cooldown_and_priority: A second opposite offset was preempted by the real dynamic obstacle guard: journal subsequently included Остановка перед препятствием and goal was cleared. This confirms obstacle priority in live operation, but does not independently prove the full 2 s cooldown. The detector cooldown and command_blocked-before-cooldown are covered by test_path_deviation_requires_time_uses_hysteresis_and_cooldown and test_motion_executor_replans_after_sustained_cross_track_deviation.
controlled_live_probe.cleanup: Probe run stopped. Simulation reset to easy seed23 generation4; backend restored to default ROS_ODOM_TOPIC=/odom and ROS_SCAN_TOPIC=/scan, then cleanup start-stop reached generation5. Native battery 59.9924/60 and odom/scan/battery/clock freshness all true.

verification.ros_callback_suite: ROS Jazzy container: test_ros_generation.py 17 passed in 0.26 s, including configurable observation-topic subscriptions.
verification.topic_configuration: ROS_ODOM_TOPIC and ROS_SCAN_TOPIC are environment-configurable in composition root/compose.yaml; production defaults remain /odom and /scan. Isolated live probe used /t10/odom and /t10/scan.

limitations: The cooldown interval is covered by deterministic domain/application tests; the attempted second live drift was preempted by a real lidar obstacle guard, so no standalone live 2 s cooldown timing claim is made.

Controlled live scenario offsets backend odometry while keeping the Gazebo robot physically stationary; measured physical drift remained below 0.01 m. It verifies route-deviation policy response, not recovery from a physical impact or wheel slip.
